headline: The four-step reordering puzzle is fully documented and the products are unique, but both gold closures leave the free-text closure reason at a hidden default, so an agent that records a reason fails.

issues.summary: close_bank_account_7392 stores its optional free-text 'reason' argument in accounts[...].closure_reason. Gold omits it, so the record gets the hidden default 'Customer requested closure'. No document says which reason to pass or to leave it out, so an agent that records a sensible reason produces a different DB state.
evidence: tools.py close_bank_account_7392 signature: reason: str = "Customer requested closure"; body: account["closure_reason"] = reason
unlock output: "reason: string (optional) - The reason for closing the account" (default value not shown)
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_005: "3. Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account." (no reason value anywhere in the KB)
issues.why_it_matters: Passing a reason (e.g. 'Customer wants to consolidate checking accounts') is a reasonable, even diligent, use of an offered parameter, but it fails DB grading. Only omitting the argument, or guessing the exact default string, matches gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Exclude closure_reason from the hashed state, or have the closure doc state the exact reason string and put it in the gold call.

solution_check: Business checking requires no CLOSED accounts (doc_(general)_003). Personal savings needs a checking account at least 14 days old: Evergreen (03/15/2025) qualifies, Light Blue (11/02/2025, 12 days) does not. Hence: open Navy Blue, open savings, then close. Navy Blue is the only business checking with a $0 fee, no minimum balance, and no expiring startup free period (Sky Blue). Silver Plus is the only savings product with at least 15 withdrawals, daily compounding, a relationship bonus, ATM rebates and a $2,500 minimum (no Platinum card, so Silver has 10 withdrawals). The user dictates the transfers ($150 Bronze to Silver Plus; $2,500 and $1,000 from Evergreen). There are no early-closure fees: Bronze is 674 days old and Evergreen 244. The gold replays cleanly, and swapping the two opens or the transfer/closure blocks gives the same hash (verified).
prior_note: The prior review rated this clean under a scorer that ignored closure_reason. Under upstream exact-hash grading, the free-text reason on both closures is compared.
notes: Data typo: db.json accounts.61c9d8e7f6a5b432.class = "saving" (not "savings"). Because of it, close_bank_account_7392 finds no early-closure config for the Bronze savings. That has no effect here (the account is past the 60-day window), and nothing else reads the class, so I list it only as an observation. Opening the business checking also requires a personal checking balance of at least $500 (Evergreen $3,500, Light Blue $600), which is met.
